name: Zlaté Moravce (Slovakia)
description: A blue field with a saltire of white and yellow, one diagonal white and the other yellow, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature Z-1/1991.

features.role: saltire with one white and one yellow diagonal
